name: Kanishk Steel Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1989, Kanishk Steel Ltd is a manufacturer and supplier of Iron & Steel products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KSL is an ISO 9001:2000 certified company and is a partof OPG Enterprises Group. The company manufactures steel products (Finished goods) both Constructional steel and Structural steel conforming to the Bureau of Indian Standards  BIS 1786 and IS 2062 (equivalent to ASTM, BS, DIN)

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 32.3 days to 16.6 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.96% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.70% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.9.82 Cr.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -3.43%
